title: On Displaying the prizes along one shelf
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：display　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 display 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the fisherman ① displayed the prizes along one shelf before dawn, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② displays the prizes along one shelf in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ display the prizes along one shelf at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ displayed the prizes along one shelf before — a line in the logbook for July 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Displaying the prizes along one shelf before dawn, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ display no fear in the open court in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Display no fear in the open court at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ displays no fear in the open court before dawn every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ displayed the prizes along one shelf again when nobody else would.

⑩ To display the prizes along one shelf, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody displays the prizes along one shelf in public again and somebody must display the prizes along one shelf before dawn all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 陈列（一般过去式 displayed the prizes along one shelf：1956 年渔人头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 陈列（一般现在 displays the prizes along one shelf：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 陈列（不定式 to display the prizes along one shelf：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 陈列（过去完成时 had displayed the prizes along one shelf：1950 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 陈列（动名词 displaying the prizes along one shelf 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 流露（display no fear in the open court：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去流露在公堂上丝毫不露怯）
G. v. 流露（display no fear in the open court：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 陈列（后段两处：新来的船工照例 displays no fear in the open court，而母亲又一次 displayed the prizes along one shelf）

display 意为“陈列”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要陈列把奖品沿一个架子陈列开来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1956 the fisherman displayed the prizes along one shelf before dawn, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman displays the prizes along one shelf in public whenever the harbour asks.
Displaying the prizes along one shelf before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
